components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action of a screen or dialog: Start game, Roll dice, Done, Rematch.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; background: #F0A73A; color: #1A1206; border: 0; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #F5BC66; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F0A73A; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Other actions: Undo, Statistics, Settings, New game.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; background: #1E2E30; color: #EEE7D9; border: 1px solid #2C4144; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #24373A; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F0A73A; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { color: #6F8380; border-color: transparent; cursor: default; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions only: Resign, Reset statistics.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; background: #2A1A19; color: #F08A7E; border: 1px solid #5A2A26; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #331F1D; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F0A73A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Choosing one of a few options: level, move speed, color.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; background: #0E1617; border: 1px solid #2C4144; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-seg-item { height: 40px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #9DB0AD; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-item:hover { color: #EEE7D9; } .ds-seg-item[aria-checked="true"] { background: #F0A73A; color: #1A1206; font-weight: 600; } .ds-seg-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F0A73A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: On and off settings: show legal moves, sound effects.
components.css: .ds-switch { width: 52px; height: 30px; padding: 3px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #2C4144; display: inline-flex; justify-content: flex-start; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-switch-knob { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: #9DB0AD; } .ds-switch[aria-checked="true"] { background: #F0A73A; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-switch[aria-checked="true"] .ds-switch-knob { background: #1A1206; } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F0A73A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat container for a group of settings, stats or a summary.
components.html:
Gameplay

Highlight the checkers you can move and where they can go.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #162224; border: 1px solid #2C4144; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; color: #EEE7D9; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; max-width: 360px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; line-height: 28px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-text { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; color: #9DB0AD; }

components.name: Player Card
components.description: A player in the game panel; the active player gets the amber border and the Your turn tag.
components.css: .ds-player { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 36px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px 14px; width: 272px; padding: 16px; background: #162224; border: 2px solid #2C4144; border-radius: 16px; color: #EEE7D9; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-player-active { border-color: #F0A73A; } .ds-player-chip { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 999px; background: #F4EFE4; border: 3px solid #C9BFAE; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-player-name { display: flex; flex-direction: column; font-size: 16px; } .ds-player-name span { font-size: 13px; color: #9DB0AD; } .ds-player-pips { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; } .ds-player-pips strong { font-family: Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-player-pips span { font-size: 12px; color: #9DB0AD; } .ds-player-tag { grid-column: 1 / -1; justify-self: start; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #F0A73A; color: #1A1206; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Checkers and target point
components.description: Ivory and onyx checkers, the selected ring, and an amber legal target with its landing spot.
components.css: .ds-felt { display: inline-flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 14px; padding: 14px; background: #1F4A44; border: 14px solid #3B2A1E; border-radius: 16px; } .ds-checker { width: 50px; height: 50px; border-radius: 999px; box-sizing: border-box; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); } .ds-white { background: #F4EFE4; border: 3px solid #C9BFAE; } .ds-black { background: #1C1C1E; border: 3px solid #4A4A50; } .ds-selected { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #F0A73A, 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); } .ds-point { position: relative; width: 56px; height: 120px; display: flex; justify-content: center; } .ds-point::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: #F0A73A; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 50% 100%); } .ds-landing { position: relative; width: 50px; height: 50px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px dashed #1A1206; box-sizing: border-box; background: rgba(26,18,6,0.12); }

components.name: Die
components.description: A die on the board; used dice fade to 35%.
components.css: .ds-dice { display: inline-flex; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; background: #1F4A44; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-die { position: relative; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 10px; background: #F4EFE4; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); } .ds-die i { position: absolute; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: #1A1206; } .ds-die i:nth-child(1) { top: 9px; left: 9px; } .ds-die i:nth-child(2) { bottom: 9px; right: 9px; } .ds-die i:nth-child(3) { top: 20px; left: 20px; } .ds-die i:nth-child(4) { top: 9px; right: 9px; } .ds-die i:nth-child(5) { bottom: 9px; left: 9px; } .ds-die-used { opacity: 0.35; }

narrative.overview:
A late-night game table. The room is dark and calm, a deep ink-teal that recedes, and the board sits in the middle of it like the only lit object: a walnut frame, teal felt, bone and oxblood points, checkers with real weight. Everything around the board is quiet so the decisions on it carry the weight.

One warm color does all the talking. Amber marks what the player can act on right now: the primary button, the selected checker, the points a checker can legally reach, the active player. When amber appears, it is an invitation. Everything else stays in the ink and bone range.

The interface is a desktop game window, not a website. Controls are solid and tactile: firm 48 px buttons, filled states, clear disabled states. Panels are flat and separated by tone; only physical objects (the board, checkers, dice) and modal dialogs cast shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ink-teal room, warm lit board as the focal point
A single amber accent reserved for actionable and active things
Outfit for anything that is read at a glance (titles, numbers), Inter for everything that is read in full
Generous 44 to 56 px hit targets everywhere, including the board

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Amber means "you can act on this" or "this is active". Never use it for decoration, headings, links that do nothing, or a losing state.

rules.name: The Board Owns The Warmth Rule
rules.body: Warm colors (walnut, bone, oxblood, amber) belong to the board and to actions. App chrome stays in the cool ink and sage range.

rules.name: The Glance Rule
rules.body: If the player reads it in under a second (a title, a number, a result), it is Outfit. If they read it as a sentence, it is Inter.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change during play uses tabular figures, so pip counts and statistics do not jitter.

rules.name: The Only Physical Things Cast Shadows Rule
rules.body: If you could pick it up off a real table (board, checker, die) or it floats over the game (a dialog), it has a shadow. Cards and panels never do.

dos: Do keep amber for actionable or active elements only (The One Lamp Rule).
Do keep every interactive element at least 44 by 44 px, including points and checkers on the board.
Do use tabular figures for pip counts, statistics and anything that updates during play.
Do show the board behind pause and game-over dialogs, dimmed by the Night Scrim, so the player never loses context.
Do give every control a visible 2 px amber focus ring for keyboard play.
donts: Don't put shadows on cards or panels; only physical pieces and dialogs are lifted.
Don't use green for buttons or anything except a win.
Don't introduce a second accent color; new states are expressed with tone, borders or amber.
Don't use warm colors in app chrome; walnut, bone and oxblood belong to the board.
Don't use gradients, glows or decorative textures on the felt or the chrome.
